title: Authentication on a networked MCP transport
description: What a networked transport of this server checks before a tool call is served. Written in this repository because FINOS publishes no control requirement for an MCP server (#270). The first three properties are the ones the CALM control-requirement meta-schema requires of every control.

control-id.description: The key of this control in the architecture file.

token-format.description: The only token format the server accepts.

verified-claims.description: Every claim the server checks on each token whatever the settings. All four are required: a token without exp is refused (#286), and one without sub is refused because rate limits and the call log are keyed on it (#320). nbf is honoured when present and is not listed because a token may omit it; scope is checked only when the next property's setting is set (#324).

scope-checked-when.description: The setting that, when set, names the scopes every token must hold. Unset, the scope claim is not checked.

key-sources.description: The settings a deployer may give the signing keys through; exactly one is set.

required-on-transports.description: The transports that do not start without authentication.

exempt-transports.description: The transports with no network boundary to authenticate.

insecure-override-setting.description: The one setting that lets a networked transport start without authentication; default false.
